food.nri_angle: Kalra's plan to open 50 restaurants across North America directly targets the Indian diaspora market, filling a gap in casual modern Indian dining that cities like New York, Toronto, and the Bay Area currently lack.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Kolkata's Iconic Flurys Opens First North India Outlet in Gurugram Ahead of Centenary
food.excerpt: The 99-year-old tearoom brings its Park Street heritage to Galleria Market as it eyes a national footprint before its 2027 centenary.
food.image_caption: Flurys, the iconic Kolkata tearoom on Park Street, has opened its first outlet in North India at Gurugram's Galleria Market ahead of its centenary in 2027.
food.nri_angle: For Bengalis and Kolkata natives abroad, Flurys evokes deep nostalgia — its expansion signals that iconic local brands are scaling nationally.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: India Today Investigation Exposes Sprawling Fake Dairy Racket Across Delhi-NCR
food.excerpt: Undercover reporting reveals synthetic paneer, adulterated milk, and fake khoya flowing into restaurants and street vendors, raising alarm about food safety enforcement gaps.
food.nri_angle: The investigation highlights food safety risks that concern diaspora members who regularly consume dairy products during visits to India and worry about the authenticity of Indian dairy exports.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From ICRISAT Lab to Rs 2 Crore Business: The Indian Scientist Behind Edible Spoons
food.excerpt: Narayana Peesapaty quit crop research to build Bakeys, the Hyderabad startup making cutlery from jowar, rice and wheat that you eat after your meal or let decompose in days.
food.image_caption: Bakey's edible cutlery, invented by former ICRISAT scientist Narayana Peesapaty, offers a biodegradable alternative to single-use plastic.
food.nri_angle: The edible cutlery movement combines Indian scientific ingenuity with global sustainability goals, exemplifying the frugal innovation model India is increasingly exporting worldwide.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Global Food Prices Set to Surge as Iran War and El Niño Squeeze Supply Chains
food.excerpt: The FAO's chief economist warns that commodity prices will start climbing by year-end, with a full-blown food price spike likely in 2027 as the Strait of Hormuz closure drives up energy and fertilizer costs.
food.nri_angle: India's dependence on imported edible oils and fertilizers means rising global food costs directly pressure domestic inflation and reduce the purchasing power of remittances.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: India Ranks 13th Among World's Best Cuisines in TasteAtlas Awards
food.excerpt: Butter garlic naan and Amritsari kulcha lead Indian entries, with Mumbai named among the world's top five food cities in the annual global food rankings.
food.nri_angle: The TasteAtlas ranking validates Indian cuisine's global standing, resonating with diaspora communities who have long championed their food traditions abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Singhara Flour Cheela: The Fasting-Friendly Pancake Worth Making Year-Round
food.excerpt: This crisp, protein-rich water chestnut flour pancake is a staple of Sawan Somwar fasting—and a gluten-free option that deserves a permanent place in the kitchen.
food.image_caption: Singhara flour cheela, a crispy water chestnut flour pancake popular during Indian fasting days, can be enjoyed year-round as a nutritious snack.
food.nri_angle: Singhara flour cheela connects diaspora families to Indian fasting traditions during Sawan, making observance possible with ingredients available through online Indian grocery retailers.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Mumbai, Delhi and Jaipur Ranked Among World's Best Street Food Cities
food.excerpt: Top chefs endorse global rankings as Mumbai's khau gallis and Delhi's Mughlai lanes earn international recognition from Time Out and TasteAtlas.
food.nri_angle: Street food serves as a visceral connection to home for the diaspora; international validation may spur more Indian street food concepts abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Canada Airports Launch Free Flow Transit, Letting International Passengers Skip Border Checks
travel.excerpt: Toronto Pearson, Vancouver, and Montréal-Trudeau now let connecting international travelers bypass customs entirely, saving up to 60 minutes on layovers.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers routing through Canadian airports to the US will benefit from faster connections, especially on the popular Delhi/Mumbai-Toronto-US corridor.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Japan Orders Mass Evacuations as Typhoon Dolphin Cancels Over 500 Flights
travel.excerpt: The Category 1 storm is bearing down on southwestern Japan with 144 kph winds, forcing 260,000 to evacuate and shuttering Toyota factories. China's eastern coast braces for landfall within days.
travel.image_caption: Typhoon Dolphin approaching southwestern Japan on Friday. The Category 1 storm has forced the evacuation of nearly 260,000 residents across Kagoshima and Okinawa prefectures.
travel.nri_angle: Indian nationals and diaspora travellers in Japan or eastern China should monitor advisories as the storm disrupts flights, rail and ferry services during peak summer travel season.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Ladakh to Launch India's First High-Altitude Wildlife Safari on Snow Leopard Trails
travel.excerpt: The newly constituted SHAN Conservation Society has directed forest officials to introduce guided jeep safaris across Hemis National Park and other protected areas, modeled on Kaziranga and Ranthambore.
travel.image_caption: Ladakh is home to 477 of India's estimated 718 snow leopards and will introduce guided jeep safaris across its high-altitude wildlife trails. The initiative aims to curb illegal off-roading while creating sustainable livelihoods for local communities.
travel.nri_angle: Ladakh's new safari program offers diaspora travelers a structured way to experience India's Himalayan wildlife, adding to the territory's appeal as a bucket-list destination for Indian-Americans and NRI adventurers.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Iberia to Chase the Solar Eclipse at 35,000 Feet in a Historic First
travel.excerpt: The Spanish airline will fly an Airbus A321XLR above the clouds on August 12 to observe Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century, livestreaming the event globally via Starlink.
travel.image_caption: An Iberia aircraft. The Spanish flag carrier is planning a special flight to chase the solar eclipse at 35,000 feet.
travel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Europe, the eclipse offers a rare celestial spectacle visible from Spain, with Valencia, Zaragoza, and Barcelona all in the path of totality — an experience not seen from the Iberian Peninsula since 1912.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: EVA Air to Launch Nonstop Taipei–Delhi Flights in December, Targeting India-US Transit Market
travel.excerpt: Taiwan's second-largest carrier plans to connect Delhi to its North American network of 10 cities, offering one-stop routes for Indian tech professionals heading to Silicon Valley.
travel.nri_angle: The new Taipei-Delhi route gives NRIs in the US, especially tech workers on the West Coast, a Pacific routing alternative for trips home.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Air India Names Ethiopian Airlines Veteran Tewolde Gebremariam as New CEO
travel.excerpt: The Tata-owned carrier appoints the architect of Ethiopian Airlines' rise as Africa's largest carrier to lead its turnaround following a fatal 2025 crash and record losses exceeding $2 billion.
travel.nri_angle: For the millions of NRIs who rely on Air India for long-haul flights between India and destinations across North America, Europe, and the Gulf, the new CEO's turnaround track record could determine whether the carrier's service, safety, and reliability finally match its expansion ambitions.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Jetstar to Charge Passengers for Overhead Locker Access Starting February 2027
travel.excerpt: Qantas's budget subsidiary will require travelers to purchase a Priority Carry-on add-on to stow bags in overhead bins, joining a global shift toward unbundled airfares.
travel.image_caption: Jetstar Airways will begin charging passengers for overhead locker access on select routes starting February 2027.
travel.nri_angle: Jetstar operates key routes between Australia and Southeast Asia used heavily by the Indian diaspora, and the carry-on fee will affect budget-conscious travelers on these corridors.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Indian-American Woman Falsely Accused of Visa Fraud in Viral Post, US Attorney Steps In
carousel.excerpt: A Houston biomedical engineer and Kuchipudi dancer was branded a visa fraudster on X. The US Attorney for Southern Texas confirmed she is a naturalized citizen.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-American woman in Houston targeted by anti-India misinformation campaign, highlighting rising online hostility toward the diaspora.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Karnataka Council Chairman Basavaraj Horatti Resigns After 46-Year Legislative Career
carousel.excerpt: The 80-year-old BJP leader and eight-time MLC steps down as Chairman of the Karnataka Legislative Council, ending one of Indian politics' longest legislative tenures.
carousel.nri_angle: Karnataka has a significant diaspora population in U.S. tech hubs, and Horatti's departure reshapes the political landscape in their home state.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses ₹350 Crore in India, Set To Dethrone Avengers: Endgame as MCU's Highest-Grosser
carousel.excerpt: Tom Holland's latest Spider-Man film collected ₹351.5 crore net in just 9 days and needs only ₹21.72 crore more to surpass Avengers: Endgame's all-time MCU record in India.
carousel.nri_angle: Spider-Man's unprecedented Indian box office run, with six-language releases and dominance across southern and metro markets, underscores India's emergence as a critical global market for Hollywood tentpole films.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Ashish Yadav Wins Silver at World U20, Ends India's 10-Year Javelin Medal Wait
carousel.excerpt: The 19-year-old threw 74.09 meters to become only the second Indian after Neeraj Chopra to medal in javelin at the World U20 Championships.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian javelin thrower Ashish Yadav's silver medal at the World U20 Championships continues the legacy Neeraj Chopra started, a source of pride for the global Indian community.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Indian Startups Raised $274 Million This Week as Cleantech and AI Lead the Surge
carousel.excerpt: A 74% jump in weekly startup funding was driven by River Mobility's $120 million Series C and strong AI deal flow across 22 companies.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian startup ecosystem's weekly funding surge reflects the tech landscape NRI investors and diaspora entrepreneurs are closely tracking.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: India's Exports Surge 15% in Q1 FY27 as FTA Network Pays Off
carousel.excerpt: Shipments to ASEAN and Africa led the growth, with engineering goods, gems, and electronics all posting double-digit gains as India pushes toward a $1 trillion export target.
carousel.nri_angle: India's expanding FTA network and export surge create new trade and investment opportunities for NRI entrepreneurs and businesses with cross-border supply chains.
